messages:
alisha: Hey - PR #23341 is ready from my side. Small routing fix + tests. Blocking on cross-region CI (linux/arm + windows matrix) and we want to avoid landing into the Tue deploy freeze. Any quick eyes/approvals? @jon for schema check please.

mike: I can take a look in ~30m. what’s the CI status link?

alisha: https://ci.internal/23341 — last run failing on windows e2e (flaky timeout). linux/arm passed 4/5.

ci-bot: CI run started for PR #23341 (branch: feature/route-fix). jobs: linux/amd, linux/arm, windows/e2e, integration.

carla: windows e2e has been flaky this week, might be unrelated. can we do a staged rebase instead of full rerun to narrow flake? (rebase -> run only windows/e2e).

jon: quick schema look now. From skim it’s fine, but can you add a short comment in routing code about fallback order? small nit.

reviewer-jen: I left 1 small comment on the client callsite (null-check). once addressed I can approve immediately.

alisha: addressed both: added comment + fixed null-check. pushed -> force-push: `git push --force-with-lease origin feature/route-fix`.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by alisha. Running windows/e2e only.

mike: if windows job is green I’ll approve and can merge after the gating SLA check. Anyone oppose merging before the Tue freeze window?

carla: prefer to avoid if it's a risky change. but this is low-risk routing tweak. if we have green e2e + 1 reviewer approval, 👍 from me.

reviewer-jen: approving now. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: windows/e2e completed — flaky timeout resolved — ALL CHECKS PASS.

sre-bot: Heads up: deploy blackout (freeze) starts Tue 2026-03-24 00:00 UTC for 6 hours for infra work. If you need to land before, do so at least 1 hour before blackout start to allow canary.

alisha: Given green CI and approvals, can we do a staged canary? mike — can you merge and kick the canary? I’ll monitor traces.

mike: I can merge now and trigger canary (will hold off if anyone needs more time). merging in 2m.

carla: please run the post-merge smoke: `./scripts/smoke-check --route /api/route` and check tracing for 5m.

mike: merged and canary started. smoke-check running...

alisha: seeing no errors in first 3m of traces. thanks all. tagging for post-merge monitor: @sre on-call if anything spikes.

sre-bot: noted — on-call paged if error rate > 2% for 5m.

mike: closing out. if anything pops up we’ll revert. :white_check_mark:

alisha: thanks everyone — saved us from needing to wait for the weekend freeze.
